objective: Test whether lexical support improves calibrated abstention without training a second model.

catalogs.nws: Pinned 69-operation OpenAPI catalog with its original calibration and holdout splits.
catalogs.library: Eight-tool authored library catalog with its original calibration and evaluation splits.

holdout_policy: Replay existing fixed holdouts once. Fit cutoffs only on each catalog's calibration labels. Transfer unchanged to the other catalogs. This diagnostic can justify a fresh validation study before any default change.
